name: Aligned  DFW-01

source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: This facility, DFW-01, is part of Aligned own Dallas area campus in Plano, Texas, at a published address of 2800 Summit Ave, Plano, TX 75074, on a 19 acre site it shares with DFW-02. Aligned states the facility is designed to Tier III standards with a 100 percent uptime SLA and 24 by 7 by 365 accessibility. No IT capacity or total square footage figure is published for this building.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] Fetched Aligned own homepage this session to discover navigation URLs, plus Aligned own about page and a press release already cited on the complete Phoenix row in this registry, aligneddc.com announcing an October 15, 2025 agreement for a consortium of the Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Partnership AIP, MGX, and BlackRock own Global Infrastructure Partners GIP to acquire 100 percent of Aligned equity from Macquarie Asset Management own private infrastructure funds, an announced enterprise value of about 40 billion dollars, expected to close in the first half of 2026. This session independently fetched that same press release and confirms its content, without independent confirmation this session that the deal has actually closed, since no later source was available. Aligned own about page states 12+ years of consistent execution, 50 campuses, and over 5 GW of operational and planned capacity across the United States and Latin America, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, but this session found no page stating a specific founding year. This operator appears in this registry under 2 field spellings, Aligned and Aligned Data Centers, both pointing to the same aligneddc.com domain and the same company, researched together this batch without merging or rewriting either operator field value. Fetched Aligned own Dallas page this session, which gives DFW-01 and DFW-02 the identical address, consistent with them being 2 buildings on 1 shared campus rather than duplicate mappings of 1 building, and gives DFW-04 a separate address on a separate, larger campus in the same city. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.
